1.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
1.asv: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.

2.web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
2.asv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.

3.web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
3.asv: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.

4.web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
4.asv: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

5.web: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.
5.asv: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: Thou artmy trust from my youth.

6.web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
6.asv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.

7.web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
7.asv: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.

8.web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.
8.asv: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.

9.web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
9.asv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.

10.web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
10.asv: For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,

11.web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
11.asv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.

12.web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
12.asv: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.

13.web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
13.asv: Let them be put to shameandconsumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.

14.web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
14.asv: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.

15.web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
15.asv: My mouth shall tell of thy righteousness, Andof thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.

16.web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
16.asv: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

17.web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
17.asv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

18.web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
18.asv: Yea, even when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not, Until I have declared thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.

19.web: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
19.asv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?

20.web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
20.asv: Thou, who hast showed us many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken us again, And wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

21.web: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
21.asv: Increase thou my greatness, And turn again and comfort me.

22.web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
22.asv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, Even thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing praises with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

23.web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
23.asv: My lips shall shout for joy when I sing praises unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

24.web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
24.asv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long; For they are put to shame, for they are confounded, that seek my hurt.
